scope: Six artificial recovery cases, three prespecified stochastic repetitions; not fast100 or full-agent generalization

decision_audit.scope: Structured observed-change support from pre-model public receipts only; free text is not verified. Planned actions are intentions, not executed facts.

limitations: The same six cases were used in development; repetitions test stochastic consistency, not generalization.
Three repetitions per case are descriptive; no population success or significance claim.
V2 has no declaration requirement; absence of a claim is neither a supported nor an unsupported explanation.
Structured support does not prove that the free-text explanation is true or that a repeated query was necessary.
All tool requests execute unchanged regardless of missing, malformed or unsupported reasons.
Only both-normally-finished pairs support resource comparison; budget stops are listed separately.
Cache hit/miss and output tokens are retained separately; total tokens do not establish monetary savings.
Repeated sensing concerns equal actor/position in this static simulator; reason text never cancels the diagnostic.
Current checks do not prove continuous on-disk source identity during execution.
